Arguments:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Set-Location 'F:\.codex\worktrees\ecs-relations-worker-3\SomeEngine.Next'
$started=[DateTime]::UtcNow
$evidence='docs/evidence/ECS-Relations-2026-10-19/focused-native-r38'
$gate=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'artifacts/benchmark-queue/09e27c3989dd4717835ef1f692127416/result.json'|ConvertFrom-Json
if($gate.ExitCode -ne 0){'STOP publication result';exit 2}
$sourceRecord=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'artifacts/ecs-relations/measurements/focused-native-r38/source.json'|ConvertFrom-Json
$source=[string]$sourceRecord.SourceCommit
if($source -ne '51c8ce75949cf16d7190e14028c655f526d5697b'){'STOP source';exit 2}
$exe='benchmarks/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Benchmarks/bin/Release/net10.0/win-x64/native-publish/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Benchmarks.exe'
$listing=@(& $exe --mode list --source $source)
$sourceExit=$LASTEXITCODE
if($sourceExit -ne 0){'STOP compiled source';exit $sourceExit}
$obj='benchmarks/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Benchmarks/obj/Release/net10.0/win-x64/native/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Benchmarks.obj'
$llvm='C:\Program Files\LLVM\bin\llvm-objdump.exe'
$before=Get-Item -LiteralPath $obj
$beforeTime=$before.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('O');$beforeLength=$before.Length
'SOURCE '+$source+' OBJECT UTC='+$beforeTime+' Length='+$beforeLength
$names=@(& $llvm -t $obj|ForEach-Object{if($_ -match '\(sec\s+2\).* 0x[0-9a-f]+ (.+)$'){$Matches[1]}})
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
$prefix='SomeEngine_ECS_SomeEngine_ECS_World__ExecuteQueryAdmitted<'
$oneWayCallers=@($names|Where-Object{$_.StartsWith($prefix) -and $_.Contains('SingleExecution') -and $_.Contains('BitmapFilter') -and $_.Contains('FixedCandidatePairs') -and $_.Contains('OneWayContacts') -and $_.Contains('OneWayPermission') -and $_.Contains('WhereSelection') -and $_.Contains('SpatialPairOutput')})
$mutualCallers=@($names|Where-Object{$_.StartsWith($prefix) -and $_.Contains('SingleExecution') -and $_.Contains('BitmapFilter') -and $_.Contains('FixedCandidatePairs') -and $_.Contains('MutualContacts') -and $_.Contains('MutualPermission') -and $_.Contains('WhereSelection') -and $_.Contains('SpatialPairOutput')})
$oneWayHand=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath 'artifacts/benchmark-queue/405449aa836c476aa06d28aa79a5bbef/stdout.log'|ForEach-Object{if($_ -match '^TARGET OneWayHand count=1 (.+)$'){$Matches[1]}})
$mutualHand=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath 'artifacts/benchmark-queue/ecacd58dfc144c24abfe70c2242d0fd7/stdout.log'|ForEach-Object{if($_ -match '^TARGET MutualHand count=1 (.+)$'){$Matches[1]}})
$points=@($names|Where-Object{$_.StartsWith('SomeEngine_ECS_SomeEngine_ECS_World__ReadEntityQueryRef<') -and $_.Contains('CollisionLayer')})
$entries=@([pscustomobject]@{Role='OneWayCaller';Names=$oneWayCallers},[pscustomobject]@{Role='OneWayHand';Names=$oneWayHand},[pscustomobject]@{Role='MutualCaller';Names=$mutualCallers},[pscustomobject]@{Role='MutualHand';Names=$mutualHand},[pscustomobject]@{Role='Point';Names=$points})
foreach($entry in $entries){'CANDIDATE '+$entry.Role+' count='+$entry.Names.Count;if($entry.Names.Count -ne 1){'STOP '+$entry.Role;exit 2}}
$roles=@($entries|ForEach-Object{[pscustomobject]@{Role=$_.Role;Name=$_.Names[0]}})
foreach($role in $roles){$hits=@($names|Where-Object{$_ -ceq $role.Name});'TARGET '+$role.Role+' count='+$hits.Count;if($hits.Count -ne 1){'STOP exact role';exit 2}}
$newDump=@(& $llvm -d -r --no-show-raw-insn ('--disassemble-symbols='+(($roles.Name)-join ',')) $obj)
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
$listing|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'native-source-list.json') -Encoding utf8
$newDump|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'native-five-functions.raw.asm') -Encoding utf8
$functions=@{};$roleName=$null
foreach($line in $newDump){
 if($line -match '^([0-9a-f]{16}) <(.+)>:$'){
  $symbol=$Matches[2];$roleName=($roles|Where-Object{$_.Name -ceq $symbol}).Role
  if($roleName){$functions[$roleName]=[Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()}
 }
 if($roleName){$functions[$roleName].Add(($line -replace '\s+#.*$','' -replace ' <.*$',' <symbol>'))}
}
foreach($role in $roles){$functions[$role.Role]|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence ('native-'+$role.Role+'.asm')) -Encoding utf8}
$templateReceipt=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'artifacts/benchmark-queue/1b0235ae0a3e483c9c78eae2e8b7fb49/result.json'|ConvertFrom-Json
$template=[string]$templateReceipt.Arguments[-1]
$functionStart=$template.IndexOf('function ReadFunctions(');$setsStart=$template.IndexOf('$sets=');$statsStart=$template.IndexOf('foreach($set in $sets)');$afterStart=$template.IndexOf('$after=')
$roleLine='$role=if($name.Contains(''HandwrittenDefaultPairs'')) {''Hand''} else {''Required''}'
$newRoleLine='$role=($roles | Where-Object {$_.Name -ceq $name}).Role'
$functionCode=$template.Substring($functionStart,$setsStart-$functionStart).Replace($roleLine,$newRoleLine)
$setsCode='$sets=@([pscustomobject]@{Version=$source;Functions=@(ReadFunctions $newDump)})'
$statsCode=$template.Substring($statsStart,$afterStart-$statsStart)
$stats=@(& ([ScriptBlock]::Create($functionCode+[Environment]::NewLine+$setsCode+[Environment]::NewLine+$statsCode)))
$stats|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'native-function-statistics.log') -Encoding utf8
$statistics=@($stats|Where-Object{$_ -match '^\{"Version"'}|ForEach-Object{$_|ConvertFrom-Json})
$statistics|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'native-function-statistics.json') -Encoding utf8
$roles|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'native-symbols.json') -Encoding utf8
$pointStart=[Convert]::ToInt64(($statistics|Where-Object Role -eq 'Point').Start.Substring(2),16)
$hot=@()
foreach($role in @($roles|Where-Object Role -ne 'Point')){
 $instructions=@(foreach($line in $functions[$role.Role]){$match=[regex]::Match($line,'^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s+([a-z][a-z0-9]*)\s*(.*)$');if($match.Success){[pscustomobject]@{Address=[Convert]::ToInt64($match.Groups[1].Value,16);Operation=$match.Groups[2].Value;Operands=$match.Groups[3].Value;Text=$line}}})
 $calls=@($instructions|Where-Object{$_.Operation -eq 'callq' -and $_.Operands -match '^0x([0-9a-f]+)' -and [Convert]::ToInt64($Matches[1],16) -eq $pointStart})
 $loops=@(for($i=0;$i -lt $instructions.Count-1;$i++){$inst=$instructions[$i];if($inst.Operation -match '^j' -and $inst.Operands -match '^0x([0-9a-f]+)'){$target=[Convert]::ToInt64($Matches[1],16);if($target -lt $inst.Address){$end=$instructions[$i+1].Address;$insideCalls=@($calls|Where-Object{$_.Address -ge $target -and $_.Address -lt $end});if($insideCalls.Count -eq 2){[pscustomobject]@{Start=$target;End=$end;Bytes=$end-$target}}}}})
 $loop=$loops|Sort-Object Bytes|Select-Object -First 1
 if($loop){$inside=@($instructions|Where-Object{$_.Address -ge $loop.Start -and $_.Address -lt $loop.End});$item=[pscustomobject]@{Role=$role.Role;Start=('0x{0:x}' -f $loop.Start);EndExclusive=('0x{0:x}' -f $loop.End);Bytes=$loop.Bytes;Instructions=$inside.Count;PointCalls=@($calls|ForEach-Object{'0x{0:x}' -f $_.Address});Code=@($inside.Text)};$hot+=$item;'HOT '+($item|Select-Object -ExcludeProperty Code|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5)}
}
$hot|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'native-hot-loops.json') -Encoding utf8
$after=Get-Item -LiteralPath $obj
$facts=[pscustomobject]@{SourceCommit=$source;PublishQueue=$gate.Id;PublishExitCode=$gate.ExitCode;SourceCommand=@($exe,'--mode','list','--source',$source);SourceExitCode=$sourceExit;Object=$before.FullName;ObjectBeforeUtc=$beforeTime;ObjectBeforeLength=$beforeLength;ObjectAfterUtc=$after.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('O');ObjectAfterLength=$after.Length;StartedAtUtc=$started;FinishedAtUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow;DisassemblyCommand=@($llvm,'-d','-r','--no-show-raw-insn',('--disassemble-symbols='+(($roles.Name)-join ',')),$obj);Targets=$roles}
$facts|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'native-reader-facts.json') -Encoding utf8
foreach($stat in $statistics){'FUNCTION '+($stat|ConvertTo-Json -Compress)}
'EVIDENCE '+(Join-Path (Get-Location) $evidence)
'OBJECT AFTER UTC='+$after.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('O')+' Length='+$after.Length
'AUDIT END UTC='+[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('O')
